File 5
Listening 1
Lyn
Excuse me, can I ask you some questions?
Sean
Er … Sure. What is it about?
Lyn
Well, I work for World Travel. I want to ask you some
questions about your travel experiences. Is that OK?
Sean
Yeah. Fine.
Lyn
So, what’s your name?
Sean
Sean Flynn.
Lyn
Shaun? Is that S-H-A-U-N?
Sean
No. It’s S-E-A-N.
Lyn
S-E-A-N. OK. My questions. Did you have a summer
holiday last year?
Sean
Well, I usually go to Spain in the summer, but I didn’t go
last year.
Lyn
Oh really?
Sean
But I did have a holiday last year. I went to France. But I
went in December.
Lisa
In December? In winter then?
Sean
Yes.
Lyn
OK. So, who did you go with? Did you go alone?
Sean
No. I wasn’t on my own. I was with my girlfriend. She’s
French, you see. So we went to Toulon in the south of
France and I met her friends there.
Lyn
OK. Thanks. So, where did you stay on holiday? Did you
stay in a hotel or a bed and breakfast?
Sean
Er … we didn’t stay in a hotel or a bed and breakfast. As I
said, my girlfriend is French. We stayed for two days at her
parents’ house then we went to her friend’s flat near the
Hotel Grand in the centre of Toulon, and we stayed with
her friend for four days. It was great.
Lyn
OK … They’re my questions. So, thank you very much.
Sean
Bye.
Lyn
Bye! Have a nice day.
File 5
Listening 2
1
Jack
When’s your birthday, Annie?
Annie
My birthday?
Jack
Yes.
Annie
It’s on the twenty-third.
Jack
The twenty-first?
Annie
No. The twenty-third. Of July. Why?
Jack
Don’t worry. No reason. It’s only because …
2
Sara
Do you usually have lunch in the café in Long Street, Joe?
Joe
Er … yes … usually … when it’s a day when I’m at work,
yes.
Sara
OK. So why did I see you in the Chinese restaurant in
High Street yesterday at one o’clock?
Joe
Er … yesterday?
Sara
Yes. Yesterday. With a tall, blonde woman, Joe. And she
wasn’t your sister!
3
Gina
Did you have a nice weekend, Frank?
Frank
Yes, it was great. We went to the beach on our bikes
yesterday.
Gina
Nice weather for a picnic.
Frank
Yes, it was, but we didn’t take sandwiches. We bought
chips from a restaurant and we ate them on the beach.
4
Andy
I phoned you last week, Tina, but you weren’t at home.
Tina
Oh? Well, I was there on Monday, but I was away for five
days from the eighth to the twelfth. Tuesday to Saturday.
Andy
Oh, right. Where did you go?
Tina
I went to stay with my sister in Whitstable.
Andy
Oh. Nice.
5
Wayne Do you use your computer a lot, Helen?
Helen
Well, yes. Last night I was on the Internet for an hour. I
checked my emails and bought a book online. But I don’t
chat online or play computer games. So, I don’t use it all
the time.
